name: Adirondack Park
story: Adirondack Park is located in northeastern New York. Established in 1892, it is the largest park in the contiguous United States at 6.1 million acres and contains old-growth forests, lakes, and the Adirondack Mountains.
matters: The park provides watershed protection and shelters old-growth forests and native wildlife. Its legal protections and management have helped conserve developed and wild lands.
